read_by: Agent-drafted, from the cell's own tier table, capability and decision log
input: Pressure ratio: (event 3-second gust / declared reference gust) squared, dimensionless, valid 0 to 2; outside the range is withheld, not clamped
out_of_scope: Storm surge and rain flooding (Flood cell)

how_to_use.share_of: Replacement value of the same physical unit, fixed 2024 dollars: $1.05M per integrated enclosure (80), $520,000 per PCS (20); $94.4M covered of $109.8M total

outputs.single_event: conditional: needs an explicit response choice (replacement or repair sensitivity), a resistance scenario and a declared comparable pressure reference
outputs.scenario_dollars: conditional: same conditions, with the same-unit value; covered hardware only
outputs.yearly_loss: conditional: Hazard computes it only after frequency, shared-event coupling, per-unit cap and annual-distribution checks pass; partial-property result only, complete-plant figures withheld

conditions: Pin the exact model v1.0 / docs r1 artifact, value and capability
No default response: choose replacement or repair sensitivity, and lower, central or upper resistance (unweighted, not probabilities)
Declare the comparable pressure reference; the cell picks no national wind reference
Cap each unit's yearly cost at its value; no repair within the year
Keep unknown source and domain probability; the $15.4M unbound property is not zero

method.summary: Solar TC-wind ordered damage-state curves reused as a T4 hypothesis, with BESS enclosure state costs from a related NREL cost split and full replacement at major damage

key_sources: Hazard BESS r1 selected profile and budget (BW-S01)
Solar TC-wind model v2.1 docs r2 (BW-S02)
SMA MVPS-S2-SCS-US system manual, storm mounting and anchorage (BW-S03)
Tesla Industrial Lithium-Ion Battery Emergency Response Guide rev 2.8 (BW-S11)
NREL PVSCM 2024 inputs and prior same-budget allocation (BW-S12)
judgment: Pressure axis is a squared gust ratio against a reference the consumer declares (BW-P01)
Curve shape and beta 0.35 borrowed from the solar TC-wind cell; no BESS data fitted (BW-P02)
Major damage means full enclosure replacement (owner-approved local policy BW-Q01)
Limited-damage cost of 20/141.3 of enclosure value from a related cost split (BW-P03)
PCS uses the solar TC-wind states and costs unchanged (BW-P07)
open_items: No national wind reference selected (BW-P08); national placement support not yet qualified
Matched wind or anchorage tests and service outcomes still needed
$15.4M of plant value has no wind response yet

rows.variants: response: approved replacement / repair sensitivity; resistance: lower, central or upper (unweighted)
rows.shape_basis: State medians and beta transferred from the solar TC-wind curve, not fitted (BW-P02)
rows.cost_basis: State costs 0 / 0.14 / 1 / 1 (repair sensitivity 0.19 at major) from policy and a related cost split (BW-P03 to P06)

notes.text: Major damage means replacing the whole enclosure (BW-Q01)
tropical_cyclone_wind_solar v2.1 docs r2 (states and costs unchanged)
